     3|*Mission AI: "Your grandparents feared Earth's embargoes. You fear the bonds that make embargoes impossible."*  
     4|*Treasurer Chao Meiling VIII: "We're not just trading goods. We're weaving a net that catches us both."*
     5|
     6|The alert came not as a crisis siren, but as an economic pulse: Trade Analysis Report - Martian-Teran Commerce Reaches Historic Highs. Treasurer Chao Meiling VIII adjusted her spectacles, the familiar weight of decades spent in recycled air and even more decades spent knowing how economies actually function when politics and profit intertwine, as she looked at the notification flashing across her console in the Valles Marineris Treasury Authority's analysis chamber.
     7|
     8|"Mission AI," she said, her voice carrying the rasp of years spent in economic planning and the quiet focus of generational expertise, "confirm the nature of this report."
